name: concat_mla_k
description: MLA key concatenation with signature concat_mla_k(k, k_nope, k_rope). k is [total_tokens,h,nope_dim+rope_dim] and supplies output shape, device and dtype; k_nope is [total_tokens,h,nope_dim]; k_rope is [total_tokens,1,rope_dim]. Return a newly allocated [total_tokens,h,nope_dim+rope_dim] tensor of k.dtype formed by k_nope followed by k_rope broadcast over heads. The contents of k are not read or copied. No input is modified. The suite exercises bfloat16; the native implementation reads k_nope and k_rope through their own strides.
